**Wiki**

This GO FAIR **wiki** is an effort to bring together past, current and future individual documentation efforts into one comprehensive resource. This website is still **under construction**. This wiki and all of its content are maintained by the [GO FAIR Foundation](https://www.gofair.foundation/). The source files of this website can be found on [Github](https://github.com/gofair-foundation/gofair-wiki).

## How to Subscribe to the GO FAIR Wiki RSS Feed

Follow these simple steps to subscribe to updates using your mobile RSS reader app (such as Feedly, NetNewsWire, Inoreader, or Reeder):

1. Copy the Feed URL: Copy the RSS feed web address to your phone's clipboard: <https://wiki.gofair.foundation/docs/news/index.xml>

2. Open Your RSS Reader App: Launch your preferred RSS app on your mobile device.

3. Add a New Feed: Tap the "+" (Add) button, "Add Subscription", or the search icon in the menu/sidebar.

4. Paste and Subscribe: Paste the link into the URL search bar, select the feed, and tap Add or Subscribe.

This website was built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org/) and rendered with [Github Pages](https://pages.github.com/).
